purpose: Tracks audited third-party/reference asset packs before any asset is promoted into Havenwild runtime content. Raw third-party files stay quarantined or user-supplied unless license and repository policy allow promotion.

rules.commercialBuildGate: commercial build may only include entries with commercialRuntimePolicy=allowed_with_attribution_or_license or project_owned_original

sources.author: Pipoya

sources.author: bluecarrot16, Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm), Casper Nilsson, Lyndsay Takacs (cyanowl), Redshrike
sources.publicRepoPolicy: raw supplied sheets may be redistributed under selected CC-BY-SA-3.0 route with attribution; preserve source credits and derivative share-alike obligations
sources.recommendedUse: modular Willowmere/city architecture after multi-cell region and structural footprint certification
sources.prohibitedUse: do not treat the 32x32 source-addressing grid as independent placeable footprints; do not publish uncertified fragments
notes: The supplied credit file lists the combined work as CC-BY-SA 3.0 / GPL 3.0. Havenwild selects the CC-BY-SA 3.0 route.
The supplied credit file does not include a canonical URL for the combined Victorian pack; underlying source URLs are preserved in the source-family contract.
